name: Storm Titan
descr: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Ball Lightning
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Titan conjure **1d4** spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes **4d6** magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

features.name: Storm Bringer
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **3d12** magic damage and are _Vulnerable_ until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Thunderclap
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.
